notes: VELSTRIA ステージの 2D 素材。画風は Arena of Valor / Honor of Kings 系の手描きスタイライズ（彩度高め・筆致あり・柔らかい陰影）。tile はシームレス化を stage_bake.py で行うので多少の継ぎ目は許容。concept は Meshy の image-to-3d に渡す。

styles.tile: Seamless tileable top-down ground texture, square, viewed straight from above (orthographic, no perspective, no horizon, no object shadows, no lighting direction). Hand-painted stylized mobile MOBA game terrain in the style of Arena of Valor / Honor of Kings / League of Legends Wild Rift: painterly brush strokes, rich but natural saturated colors, soft value variation at several scales, no large single features, uniform density so it tiles seamlessly on all four edges. No text, no border, no vignette, evenly and flatly lit.
styles.decal: Top-down orthographic view of a single flat ground feature, centered, filling about 92% of a square canvas, perfectly circular and symmetric, on a flat plain neutral mid-grey (#808080) background outside the circle. Hand-painted stylized mobile MOBA game art in the style of Arena of Valor / Honor of Kings: painterly, crisp readable shapes, soft ambient occlusion in grooves, evenly lit from straight above, no perspective, no cast shadows outside the object. No text, no border.
styles.concept: Single 3D game environment asset concept render for a stylized mobile MOBA (Arena of Valor / Honor of Kings / League of Legends Wild Rift art direction): hand-painted textures, chunky readable silhouette, soft painterly shading, saturated natural colors. Show exactly ONE object, whole and uncropped, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above (about 30 degrees), isolated on a plain flat light-grey (#d8d8d8) background, no ground plane, no cast shadow on the background, no other objects, no text, no frame.

assets.use: 地面: 草地（ジャングル・レーン脇）
assets.prompt: lush grass meadow; mostly mid-green with deep teal-green shadow patches and warm yellow-green sunlit highlights; small clusters of painted grass blades, a few clover leaves and very few tiny pale flowers; keep it calm (low contrast details) so units on top stay readable.

assets.use: 地面: 森の下草（壁際・木陰・ブッシュ下）
assets.prompt: dense dark forest-floor undergrowth: deep teal-green and emerald grass, small fern fronds, dark moss, scattered fallen leaves, cooler and darker overall than an open meadow, gentle highlight strokes.

assets.use: 地面: レーンの土道
assets.prompt: dry packed earth path: warm ochre, sandy orange-brown and light tan clay ground with hand-painted irregular polygonal cracks (like dried mud plates), a few small pebbles and grit, subtle darker worn areas; warm and slightly desaturated, not red.

assets.use: 地面: 拠点・祭壇まわりの石畳
assets.prompt: old irregular flagstone paving: large worn pale grey-blue and warm beige stone slabs of varied sizes with rounded chipped edges, thin dark grout lines with a little green moss and grass growing in the joints, soft painted highlights on each slab.

assets.use: 崖・岩の側面（三平面投影）
assets.prompt: stylized cliff rock surface seen face-on: chunky layered grey stone with cool blue-grey shadows and warm light-grey top facets, angular cracks and strata, painterly highlights on edges, faint patches of green moss, no sky.

assets.use: 崖の上面・岩の上の苔
assets.prompt: thick soft moss and short grass carpet on top of rocks: vivid green with yellow-green highlights and dark teal hollows, tiny leaves and moss tufts, fluffy painterly texture.

shallow riverbed under clear water seen from above: smooth rounded pebbles and stones in teal, slate-blue and sandy colors, patches of fine sand and a little green algae, soft caustic-like light variation, cool teal overall.

assets.use: 祭壇（中立オブジェクトの台座）の上面
assets.prompt: ancient carved circular stone platform seen from directly above: concentric rings of pale grey-blue stone with carved runic glyphs and a central star/compass emblem, worn cracks, thin moss and grass in the grooves, a raised outer rim of segmented stone blocks.

a wide chunky cliff rock formation about twice as wide as tall: big rounded grey stone blocks with flat-ish faceted sides, layered cracks, thick bright green moss and short grass blanketing the top surfaces and dripping over the upper edges, a few small ferns on top.

assets.use: Meshy: 壁の岩塊（縦長・柱状）
assets.prompt: a tall cluster of three stacked grey stone rock pillars of different heights, chunky faceted stylized shapes, green moss caps and grass tufts on their tops, small rubble stones around the base.
a single medium mossy boulder: rounded chunky grey-blue rock with a few angular facets and cracks, a green moss cap on top and a little grass at its base.

a stylized broadleaf tree: short thick twisted brown trunk with visible roots, a big dense canopy made of several chunky rounded leaf clumps in rich green with yellow-green highlights and teal shadows.

assets.use: Meshy: 背の高い木（外周の森）
assets.prompt: a tall stylized forest tree: slender slightly curved trunk, layered stacked canopy of chunky teal-green leaf clumps forming a tall tapering crown, darker green underside.

assets.use: Meshy: 低木（崖の上・装飾）
assets.prompt: a round leafy shrub bush: dense cluster of chunky rounded leaf clumps in vivid green with yellow-green highlights and darker teal-green shadows, a few small white flowers, wider than tall.

a broken ancient stone pillar ruin: weathered cream-beige carved stone column on a square plinth, the top broken off unevenly, carved bands with faded crimson-red painted ornaments and a small round bronze emblem, moss and vines creeping up the base.

a ruined ancient stone gateway: two weathered cream-beige stone pillars joined by a cracked carved lintel arch, crimson-red painted trim and small vertical red slit windows, a few fallen stone blocks, moss and grass on the top.
